name: Gasconade Hills Resort
description: Family resort on the Gasconade River at Richland with cabins, a campground and a swimming pool, running float trips with canoes, kayaks, rafts and tubes.

name: Froggy's River Resort
description: Campground on the Gasconade River at Richland with primitive riverbank tent sites, water-and-electric and full-hookup RV sites, three lodging units, a free shower house and a camp store. Canoe, kayak, raft and tube rental on site.

name: Ruby's Landing
description: Year-round campground on the Gasconade River north of Waynesville: 11 cabins plus a tiny home, 99 RV sites with 20/30/50-amp water and sewer, and primitive sites with and without electric. Five-mile floats all finish at the property, and private vessels can be shuttled.

name: BSC Outdoors
description: Boiling Spring Campground, a full-service outfitter running 3-, 5- and 8-mile float trips on both the Gasconade and the Big Piney. Canoes, kayaks, rafts, tubes and jon boats, with tent sites, full-hookup RV sites, cabins, a camp store and Wi-Fi.
